title: slots_specific membership: what a reader takes 'tied to this term and to no other term' to mean
record: one record per (reader, term, field). A field is in the catalog if any coded reader or the comparison key names it in slots_specific for that term.
null_rule: null means NOT_RECORDED. No field has a default. true / false / an enum value appear only when someone recorded them, and the *_provenance beside it says who.

provenance_values.SCRIPT_DERIVED: computed by m01_code.py from the packet's own sources (running cplay code, parsing P3 / numcheck text) or from a filed evidence file named in the value's source_basis
provenance_values.CODER_INFERRED: set by the coder from reading the sources or a reader's note; not mechanically checked; the coder is named in the study's notes
provenance_values.READER_STATED: taken verbatim from the reader's filed response; m01_code.py checks the quote is a substring of that reader's file
provenance_values.NOT_RECORDED: nobody recorded it; the value is null

reader_id.note: the the readings folder (not included) folder name, never reader_label (which the task text set for every reader)

packet.note: variant null when the reader's variant was not stated

condition.note: D0 = brief unchanged; D1-D3 are M02 conditions, never pooled with D0

source.note: properties of the packet's sources, the same for every reader

origin.note: RAW_INPUT: passed in or recorded raw and stored; PARAMETER_ONLY: a parameter of a function written for the term, not stored under that name; COMPUTED: computed from other candidate fields or by the source after construction; DOCUMENTED: named only in prose, a notation or a key list, with no instance built in the packet

presence_scope.note: is the key present (even as None) on every instance of this term and on no instance of another term

applicability_scope.note: is it populated (non-None, non-zero) on every / some instances of this term only

requirement_scope.note: does a source rule require it for this status only (removing it raises or refuses)

routes.note: number of source routes to 'the instance' of the term that give different lists

cases.note: the [a reader] test-matrix cells, assigned by the fixed rule in M01_CRITERIA.md section 3; a field can sit in more than one

source_basis.note: how each value was obtained (the run, the parsed lines, or the filed evidence file)

listed.note: NOT_LISTED is not 'excluded': the reader was never asked to exclude

basis_quote.note: verbatim from the reader's source_lines_read, or null

basis_kind.note: the coder's classification of basis_quote; null when there is no quote

uncertainty_stated.note: true only when the reader's own text says it is unsure about this field; null otherwise (silence is not certainty)

provenance.note: listed is read from the reader's slots_specific list
